name: The Prank 3
source:
Follow three students that have all been invited to their professor’s house one fateful evening. None of them know why they are there, but each hold a secret about a way that they have pranked their teacher. Each will be grilled by their professor and it is up to you to decide whether or not they fes up to their prank, or stay silent. 

[Edited from [url=https://pelted-pixel-games.itch.io/the-prank-3]itch.io[/url]]
